description: Vivitar于1978年推出的旁轴相机。配备38mm f/2.8 (4 elements, 3 groups) with 46mm filter thread.。快门速度1/30-1/650s.。感光度ISO 25-400.。0.9m to infinity.。

specs.镜头: 38mm f/2.8 (4 elements, 3 groups) with 46mm filter thread.
specs.取景器: Brightline frame, parallax correction marks, overexposure and underexposure warning zones, with indicated approximate combined shutter speed and aperture (f/2.8 to f/14) selection shown by needle.
specs.电池: Originally took a PX625 mercury cell. A zinc air equivalent or a higher voltage alkaline button battery can be used.
specs.英文简介: The Vivitar 35EE is a 35mm rangefinder camera with automatic exposure, rebadged to Vivitar specifications from the Cosina Cosina 35 in the mid-1970s.
